Key asks: 
- Update invoice "Bill To" to: Asteria Therapeutics, Inc. (EIN: 98-7654321)
- New remit address: 210 Harbor Way, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401
- Update VAT/tax tagging: US federal EIN above; for EU entities we will supply VAT numbers if/when they are billed separately
- Effective date for routing: invoices dated on/after 2026-09-01 should be sent to the consolidated entity

I've attached a short PDF with the official invoicing instructions and a contact for our AP team. Please confirm the internal Redwood contacts you want us to coordinate with and any paperwork you need from our legal team.

Thanks,
Priya Desai

Asteria Therapeutics

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear note and congrats on the close. We can make the routing changes, but we want to ensure we have the right approvals and a brief mutual action plan so invoices don't get lost during the cutover.

Proposed next steps (suggested timeline):
1) Internal sign-off & onboarding (Redwood billing ops): confirm remit address and bank details — by 2026-08-27 (Laura)
2) Legal amendment (if required) — Asteria legal provides signed amendment if you need a contract entity switch — by 2026-08-30 (Priya / Rajiv)
3) Test invoice + payment verification (finance teams): Redwood will issue a $0/test invoice or sample invoice to invoices@asteriatx.com to validate routing — target 2026-08-31
4) Go-live: Redwood starts issuing invoices to consolidated entity for invoice dates on/after 2026-09-01

Please confirm: do you want us to keep legacy entities receivable for pre-close invoices (we recommend yes, leave historic invoices untouched), and will your AP team accept Redwood invoices with the new remit as the only change? If you need any PO mapping or GL code changes, include that in your reply.

Laura — looping you in to take point on the billing-side and to prepare the wire/ACH instructions template. Marissa — adding you for any contract redline support.

-rishi
